sloka: श्यामानि चिर युक्तत्वात् तथा सम्स्थानवन्ति च ।तानि एव एतानि मन्ये अहम् यानि रामो अन्वकीर्तयत् ॥५-१५-४३॥
transliteration: śyāmāni cira yuktatvāt tathā samsthānavanti ca ।tāni eva etāni manye aham yāni rāmo anvakīrtayat ॥5-15-43॥

translations.english: "I think these ornaments are the same that were described by Rama. Those dropped (by Sita) are not found on her body. These were not dropped.There is no doubt."
